0022600225.text: The Rockets, now 8-3 (5-1 at home) and 7-3 over their last ten, host the Warriors, who are 7-3 and riding a seven-game winning streak, in the 12th game of the season for Houston. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) and has Oscar Tshiebwe listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Golden State is missing Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), with Brandon Williams day-to-day with a hamstring issue. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
